 Watch 1st Look at Knicks' Jalen Brunson as 'Detective Madison' in 'Law & Order: SVU' Trailer
 Mike Chiari Oct 30, 2026 A promo for an upcoming episode of Law & Order: SVU featuring New York Knicks guard and reigning NBA Finals MVP Jalen Brunson as a detective officially dropped on Thursday.
 In the preview for the show, which will air on Thursday, Nov. 5, Brunson is seen speaking with the main character, Olivia Benson, who is played by Mariska Hargitay.
